chunks: Do you think you will get away before God knows who among you fought and did not take anyone but God, His Apostle and the faithful, as their friends? God is cognisant of all that you do.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that God knows who among us has truly fought and remained loyal?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the necessity of *jihād* and *walāyah* (loyalty) to the Prophet and the faithful as criteria for true faith, distinguishing sincere believers from hypocrites. It highlights that divine testing is not arbitrary but serves to reveal those who maintain exclusive allegiance to God, His Messenger, and the community of believers, rejecting false intermediaries.
